task_reconstruction.summary: Predict the medal-less status of many countries, then the medal count.
Estimate the great coach effect and other factors.
Predict changes in the role of momentum and guide player play.
Evaluate the prediction and apply it to other sports events.

contributions.summary: A zero-medal XGBoost classifier plus a TPE-XGBoost regressor.
A bootstrap prediction interval with PICP after 1000 rounds.
An OLS difference-in-differences for one named coach and two programs.
A two-track participation strategy read off a SHAP summary plot.

dependency_graph.summary: The classifier probability becomes a first-medal call at 0.2.
The coach coefficient is scaled by a country's own score and applied to three other programs.

assumptions.summary: Only medal data, event factors, and coaching. Rules are stable and remained immune.
Coaches' impacts are comparable across countries and sports.
Five new events add 2 medals each in 2028.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: Data from 1952, with scandal years, boycott years, and the East German doping program excluded.
The smallest team in an event is set to 1, and the others are scaled.
